'''Rusher's Brigade''' was a unit of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] active during the [[Republic Dark Age]] under the command of [[Jarrow Rusher]], operating from the ship [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']]. It consisted of eight [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]], each of which was named after an ancient weapon. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], they were recruited by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] to fight in an [[Battle of Gazzari|ambush]] against Daiman's brother [[Odion]]. Of the three thousand members of the brigade to enter the battle, all but five hundred sixty were reported killed or missing.
